figs.name: wheatstone-bridge-circuit-balance-diagram
figs.alt: Wheatstone bridge circuit diagram with R1, R2, R3, unknown Rx, DC supply and galvanometer
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog of a Wheatstone bridge with known arms R1 and R2, adjustable R3, unknown Rx, DC excitation and galvanometer, with the balance formula worked example.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Wheatstone bridge circuit with R1 R2 R3 Rx, DC excitation and galvanometer</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Wheatstone Bridge Circuit</text>
<line x1="300" y1="80" x2="160" y2="260" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="196.0" y="157.0" width="68" height="26" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" transform="rotate(127.9 230.0 170.0)"/>
<text x="190" y="160" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">R1</text>
<line x1="160" y1="260" x2="300" y2="440" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="196.0" y="337.0" width="68" height="26" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" transform="rotate(52.1 230.0 350.0)"/>
<text x="190" y="375" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">R2</text>
<line x1="300" y1="80" x2="440" y2="260" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="336.0" y="157.0" width="68" height="26" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" transform="rotate(52.1 370.0 170.0)"/>
<text x="415" y="160" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">R3</text>
<line x1="440" y1="260" x2="300" y2="440" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="336.0" y="337.0" width="68" height="26" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" transform="rotate(127.9 370.0 350.0)"/>
<text x="415" y="375" font-size="20" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Rx</text>
<circle cx="300" cy="80" r="6" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<circle cx="300" cy="440" r="6" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<circle cx="160" cy="260" r="6" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<circle cx="440" cy="260" r="6" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<line x1="160" y1="260" x2="262" y2="260" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="338" y1="260" x2="440" y2="260" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="300" cy="260" r="36" fill="#fef9c3" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="300" y="268" font-size="22" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">G</text>
<text x="160" y="296" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">B</text>
<text x="440" y="296" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">D</text>
<polyline points="300,80 70,80 70,240" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<polyline points="70,280 70,440 300,440" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="50" y1="240" x2="90" y2="240" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<line x1="60" y1="280" x2="80" y2="280" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="5"/>
<text x="100" y="236" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">+</text>
<text x="40" y="320" font-size="19" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">VIN</text>
<text x="40" y="344" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">DC</text>
<rect x="510" y="70" width="270" height="420" rx="14" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="645" y="110" font-size="19" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Balance condition</text>
<text x="645" y="150" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">R1 / R2 = R3 / Rx</text>
<text x="645" y="190" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Rx = (R2 × R3) / R1</text>
<text x="645" y="230" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle"></text>
<text x="645" y="270" font-size="19" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Worked example</text>
<text x="645" y="310" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">R1 = 100 Ω, R2 = 100 Ω</text>
<text x="645" y="350" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">R3 = 250 Ω</text>
<text x="645" y="390" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Rx = (100 × 250) / 100</text>
<text x="645" y="430" font-size="19" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Rx = 250 Ω</text>
<text x="400" y="520" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">At balance B and D are at equal voltage, so no current flows through G</text>
</svg>

figs.name: wheatstone-bridge-measurement-steps-flowchart
figs.alt: how a Wheatstone bridge measures resistance flowchart with balanced and unbalanced modes
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the Wheatstone bridge measuring sequence: known ratio, DC excitation, midpoint comparison, then null balance or a millivolt output that is amplified.
figs.after_h2: How a Wheatstone Bridge Measures Resistance
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Wheatstone bridge measurement sequence flowchart</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">How a Wheatstone Bridge Measures Resistance</text>
<rect x="30" y="70" width="225" height="84" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="142.5" y="106.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1. Known resistors</text>
<text x="142.5" y="130.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">set the ratio</text>
<line x1="257" y1="112" x2="283" y2="112" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="285" y="70" width="225" height="84" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="397.5" y="106.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2. DC excitation</text>
<text x="397.5" y="130.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">energizes bridge</text>
<line x1="512" y1="112" x2="538" y2="112" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="540" y="70" width="225" height="84" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="652.5" y="106.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3. Compare the</text>
<text x="652.5" y="130.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">two midpoints</text>
<polyline points="652,156 652,185 400,185 400,200" fill="none" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,205.0 590.0,260 400,315.0 210.0,260" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="267.0" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ratios match?</text>
<polyline points="210,260 150,260 150,330" fill="none" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="180" y="248" font-size="17" fill="#15803d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<polyline points="590,260 650,260 650,330" fill="none" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="620" y="248" font-size="17" fill="#b91c1c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="25" y="335" width="255" height="110" rx="10" fill="#dcfce7" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="152.5" y="372.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Balanced: 0 mV</text>
<text x="152.5" y="396.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">no current in G</text>
<text x="152.5" y="420.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Rx = R2 × R3 / R1</text>
<rect x="520" y="335" width="255" height="110" rx="10" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="647.5" y="372.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Unbalanced</text>
<text x="647.5" y="396.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">small mV appears</text>
<text x="647.5" y="420.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">size shows change</text>
<rect x="300" y="350" width="200" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="384.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Null mode:</text>
<text x="400.0" y="407.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">adjust R3</text>
<line x1="518" y1="390" x2="502" y2="390" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="298" y1="390" x2="282" y2="390" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="470" y="470" width="305" height="70" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="622.5" y="499.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4. Amplify the mV signal</text>
<text x="622.5" y="522.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">in sensors (deflection mode)</text>
<line x1="647" y1="447" x2="647" y2="468" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="235" y="505" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Outputs: 0.0 mV balanced, 4.2 and 18.6 mV unbalanced</text>
</svg>
